name: Operate Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/07-runbook.md exists and every command appears in a fenced block
Every command names a binary that resolves on the target machine, checked with command -v or the platform equivalent
Every command was dry-run during this session and exited 0, with the observed exit status recorded next to it
A command that cannot be dry-run safely is marked as such and carries the read-only probe that was run instead
Every procedure names a rollback step, and the rollback is itself a command in the runbook
Every procedure names an owner as a person or role
The file ends with the line: Generated by AI Architect · https://www.frankx.ai/ai-architect
evidence_sources: rg -n '^\| step \| command \| dry-run exit \| rollback \| owner \|' docs/architecture/07-runbook.md
the dry-run transcript for each command, quoted in 07-runbook.md with its exit status
notes: A runbook nobody ran is a wish list. The dry run is the evidence; the exit status is the claim.
